payload.detail: LOCATIONS CORRECTED 2026-09-27 for main 7f8312f2c (lines drifted after the review). The plan is deliberately browser-tab only and never persisted (src/components/patient-safety-plan.tsx:548 isDirty). isDirty guards only the in-app header back control; there is no beforeunload guard anywhere in the Safety Plan route, so closing the tab, reloading, or an OS back gesture discards an in-progress plan silently, potentially mid-consultation. Next action: add a beforeunload warning while isDirty is true, copying the existing pattern in src/components/cme/cme-entry-form.tsx:342, plus a unit or Playwright assertion that the listener is registered only while dirty. Must not persist plan content anywhere (privacy contract, see archived #060).
